site.title: 1 · Site and Nord Pool
site.description: Select the official Home Assistant Nord Pool integration, configured for DKK. PE automatically reads DKK/MWh excluding VAT and displays øre/kWh. DK1/DK2 use Europe/Copenhagen. Install the official source first; no legacy Nordpool integration is needed. Submitting a step saves it immediately. Closing keeps completed steps; unsent fields are not saved.

grid.title: 2 · Grid tariff
grid.description: Choose Radius C only if your connection uses that product. The verified Datahub time-of-use rates are automatic. Other grid products require your confirmed marginal rate. National Energinet charges, electricity tax and 25% VAT are added only within verified effective dates. Submitting a step saves it immediately. Closing keeps completed steps; unsent fields are not saved.

grid_rate.title: 2 · Manual grid rate
grid_rate.description: Enter the actual variable rate from your contract, with decimal point or comma. Zero is accepted only when you explicitly enter it. Without the confirmation below, the rate starts at the next complete quarter and statistics cover the remaining day. No historical or future private contract is guessed. Submitting a step saves it immediately. Closing keeps completed steps; unsent fields are not saved.

data.whole_day: I confirm this rate also applied earlier today

supplier.title: 3 · Supplier markup
supplier.description: Enter your supplier markup, including any variable trading fee. PE does not reconstruct household bills or allocate subscriptions. EWII is not a default; confirm your actual contract. Enter the actual variable rate from your contract, with decimal point or comma. Zero is accepted only when you explicitly enter it. Without the confirmation below, the rate starts at the next complete quarter and statistics cover the remaining day. No historical or future private contract is guessed. Submitting a step saves it immediately. Closing keeps completed steps; unsent fields are not saved.

data.whole_day: I confirm this rate also applied earlier today

review.title: Saved setup
review.description: Site: **{name}**. Completed steps are saved. Check prices retries verification. Nine sensors and the bundled card show coverage, components and the corrective action for missing prices. Advanced is only for confirmed dated rates.

advanced.title: Advanced · Dated marginal rates
advanced.description: Effective dates are local, with an exclusive end date. Optional hours are local 0–23; both repeated DST hours use the same rate. Manual rules override public defaults. Remove an overlapping manual rule before adding its replacement.

add_rate.title: Add a confirmed rate
add_rate.description: Only enter a rate you can verify for the entire chosen period. Unknown future rates remain unavailable. Removing a private rule never makes it zero. Existing past calculated prices remain immutable. Submitting a step saves it immediately. Closing keeps completed steps; unsent fields are not saved.

data.confirm: I verified this rate for the entire effective period

remove_rate.title: Remove a manual rate
remove_rate.description: Only the selected rule is removed. Future affected prices become unavailable until verified again. Past recorded prices are preserved.

reset.title: Reset this site
reset.description: Site: **{name}**. Breaking beta.10 requires recreating older beta sites. Back up first. This action stops and removes this site, its PE SQLite history, revisions and PE files. It does not delete other sites, Recorder or unrelated HA data. Type the exact site name and confirm. Normal HA Delete retains PE history files.

data.name: Type the exact site name
data.confirm: Permanently delete only this site and its PE history

error.invalid_source: Select a configured official DK1/DK2 Nord Pool source and enter a site name.
error.source_missing: Add the official Home Assistant Nord Pool integration first. Configure DK1/DK2 and DKK.
error.invalid_amount: Enter a finite non-negative decimal rate, such as 3.75 or 3,75. Check conflicting dated periods under Advanced.
error.invalid_rate: Confirm the entire period, use an end date after the start, and remove overlapping manual rules.
error.confirm_reset: Type the exact site name and tick the permanent deletion confirmation.
error.reset_failed: Reset could not safely finish. No other site is affected. Check file permissions and retry this reset.

abort.saved_reload_failed: The step was saved, but the site could not reload. Check storage and integration logs, then reopen Configure.
abort.site_reset: This site and its PE history were removed. Add a new Energy Price Engine site to start again.
